display.purpose: Site name in the title window only.

headline.purpose: Addon name in the help window; 21px when the name exceeds 16 characters.

title.purpose: Gold window titles and starter-set names.

menu-line.purpose: Addon names (17px) and category labels (16px) on menu lines.

label.purpose: Gold field label, help sub-line and section heads (14-15px).

meta.purpose: Counts, dates, stars, confidence line, set notes.

shadows.name: window-float
shadows.purpose: Every window, and only windows: inner highlight plus ambient float.

motion.name: state-fill
motion.purpose: Hover and selection fills on lines, buttons, chips.

motion.name: cursor-bob
motion.value: translateX(-2px) to translateX(2px), .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate

motion.name: help-in
motion.purpose: Help window content change (not on arrow-key moves).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables bob, help-in and all transitions.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: stacked windows, horizontal category scroller, help inline under the picked line, stars hidden.

narrative.overview:
The catalog is a set of in-game menu windows floating on a night-navy ground. Every region of the page (title, categories, addon list, help, starter sets, research) is the same object: a translucent, top-lit blue panel with a thin periwinkle frame and a faint inner highlight. The player moves a white pointing-hand cursor down a dense list of names, and a help window explains whichever line the cursor rests on. The page is navigated the way a game menu is navigated, arrow keys included.

Density is high and calm: 40px menu lines, a single rounded face at a few weights, gold reserved for window titles, field labels and the selected line, and colour otherwise carried only by the eight elemental crystal marks that identify categories. There is no imagery, no game art, no logo; the world is built entirely from panels, type, a cursor and crystals. The build refuses the category default of a flat dark table with tag pills: category is a crystal glyph drawn in SVG, never a coloured pill on the row.
keyCharacteristics: Every region is a window: same gradient, frame, inner highlight and 8px radius.
One typeface (M PLUS Rounded 1c) at 400/500/700/800, tabular numerals throughout.
Gold marks titles and the current selection; nothing else competes with it.
A bobbing white pointing hand marks the selected category and the selected addon.
Categories are faceted SVG crystals in eight elemental colours.
Three-column desktop menu collapses at 900px to stacked windows with the help text opening inline under the picked line.

rules.name: The Gold Is The Cursor Rule
rules.body: Gold marks a title or the thing the cursor is on. A new surface gets gold for its window title and its selected item; body copy, metadata and decoration do not.

rules.name: The Crystals Only Rule
rules.body: The eight elemental hues appear only as crystal marks (9-14px) beside category and addon names. They never fill backgrounds, tint text, or become pills.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: M PLUS Rounded 1c is the only family; hierarchy comes from weight (400/500/700/800) and size, never from a second face.

rules.name: The Cursor Gutter Rule
rules.body: Every menu line reserves a 24px cursor column plus a 10px gap; window titles and list-head content are indented 34px so text aligns with the line labels, not the cursor.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: Only windows cast a shadow. Lines, chips, buttons and fields never lift; state is shown with `band`/`hover` fills.

dos: Do put every new region in a window: gradient, 1px `frame`, inner highlight, 8px radius, gold 20px/800 title.
Do mark the current item with the white pointing-hand cursor and the `band` fill, and keep arrow-key movement.
Do identify a category with its crystal colour and the faceted gem shape.
Do flag automation honestly: the coral Auto badge on the line and the risk note in help.
Do keep numerals tabular and metadata in `ink-2` at 14px.
Do stop the cursor bob, help fade and hover transitions under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
donts: Don't render categories as coloured tag pills on list rows; the crystal is the category mark.
Don't use gold for body copy or decoration; it belongs to titles, labels and the selection.
Don't add shadows to anything inside a window.
Don't introduce a second typeface, game art, or Square Enix / Windower logos.
